source.text:
So I'm a bit of a domain-grabbing addict, and at some point I just wanted a checker that I can quickly use instead of *, which has gone somewhat slow and bulky over time.

I ended up building my own, and it runs entirely from the browser (the page is static, no server or tracking for searched domains); the page asks the registries itself over RDAP (or DNS-over-HTTPS where RDAP isn't available).

There's also a list of 210 names I sourced (and will keep sourcing) with Claude, along with some ideas for each, which are all available at the time of posting.

A small feature I initially added just for testing but which ended up to be the main time killer for me was the "die", which basically just rolls a random adjective-noun using faker, and which ends up with interesting (and at times provocative) ideas.

Anyway, just a weekend project, I don't and am not planning to earn anything form it, just thought to share with fellow addicts Pls use responsibly!

* -- not sure if I can mention (not really) a "competitor" here hence redacted
source.title: Show HN: Unsquatted – fast domain checker and curated list
